cr_data.provenance: [The Intimate Gallery, New York, by 1928; sold to Sachs]; Paul J. Sachs, Cambridge, MA (from 1928; given to Forbes); Margaret Laighton (Mrs. Edward W.) Forbes, Cambridge, MA (before 1946-d. 1966); her husband Edward Waldo Forbes, Cambridge, MA (1966-d. 1969); [Doris Meltzer Gallery, New York, about 1970]; [Andrew Crispo Gallery, Inc, New York, 1972-about 1983; sold to private collection]; Private collection, New York (before 1986); [Gerald Peters Gallery, Santa Fe, NM, by 1986; Stock Number: B-5936-0; sold to Westheimer]; Jerome M. Westheimer, Ardmore, OK (1986-d. 2004; his bequest to OKCMOA)(Source: OKCMOA, 2025)
remarks_1999: Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks indicate, "Sold to Paul J. Sachs . . . . Postcard from Mr. Sach's secretary, May 1946: 'The Georgia O'Keeffe formerly in Mr. Sach's collection he gave some years ago to Mrs. Edward W. Forbes. I do not know, but I imagine it is still in her collection.'" (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.title: Calla Lily

description: A white calla lily attached to a bright green stem spirals in on itself. The yellow tones in the curved stem contrast with the bluish, veined leaf that stretches across the narrow canvas. Behind the plant is a purplish-gray, plain background.
imageCaption: Courtesy of Oklahoma City Museum of Art.
title: Calla Lily
